image_description: A medium-shot of an adult orangutan walking on all fours (knuckle-walking posture) across a grassy field. The subject has characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and extremely long arms that reach the ground. The face is visible with a broad structure, though cheek pads are not prominently exaggerated, suggesting it may be a female or sub-ad male. The background consists of out-of-focus green vegetation.
